restaurantName: The Tea House at Bread Ahead
bio: Afternoon Tea Awards 2024 - Award of Excellence  The Tea House is located upstairs at Bread Ahead Pavilion Road bakery, a welcoming and elegant space to indulge in an afternoon with family and friends. The dining room overlooks the dedicated pastry kitchen uniquely designed to produce iconic British Afternoon Tea. The menu embraces seasonality and traditional bakes expertly paired with a selection of Fortnum and Mason teas.  The Tea House has been crafted with the Bread Ahead ethos in mind, traditional values teamed with creative execution. The Afternoon Tea is a celebration of everything they love as bakers and pastry chefs, you can expect all the bright and bold Bread Ahead flavours in a truly special setting. Relax and indulge in the beautiful surroundings, savour the sights and sounds and of course drink plenty of tea.  The Afternoon Tea is a journey through the classics with flavour and ingredients front and centre. Delight in a generous feast of sweet and savoury bakes, alongside changing seasonal sweets you can expect traditional cakes from Black Forest to Battenberg and warm fresh scones with homemade jam, lemon curd and clotted cream.
